labels.shortDescription: Load one object: the new mapping has no name
labels.value: Give the template a name.

labels.shortDescription: Load one object: the record ID choice for a column or lookup
labels.value: Salesforce record ID

labels.shortDescription: Load one object: user lacks the object access; {0} is the object
labels.value: You cannot read, create or edit {0} as this template needs. Ask your Salesforce administrator for access, or choose another action for each row.

labels.shortDescription: Load one object: people load by update only; {0} is the object plural
labels.value: {0} can only be updated by record ID here. Add new people and organizations with a people template, which also builds their households.

labels.shortDescription: Load one object: no column is mapped to a field of the object
labels.value: No column is mapped to a field of the object. Map at least one column in the columns step.

labels.shortDescription: Load one object: update by record ID has no record ID column
labels.value: Update by record ID needs a column mapped to Salesforce record ID.

labels.shortDescription: Load one object: upsert has no external ID field chosen
labels.value: Updating or creating by external ID needs the external ID field rows are matched on. Choose it in the matching step.

labels.shortDescription: Load one object: the upsert field cannot be used; {0} is the field
labels.value: Rows cannot be matched on {0}: it is not an external ID text field of this object that you can read. Choose another field.

labels.shortDescription: Load one object: no column for the upsert field; {0} is the field
labels.value: Updating or creating by external ID needs a column mapped to {0}, the field rows are matched on.

labels.shortDescription: Load one object: a value for every row names the record; {0} field
labels.value: A value for every row cannot be {0}: every row would then name the same record. Map {0} to a column of the file instead.

labels.shortDescription: Load one object: value too long; {0} field, {1} the length it holds
labels.value: The value for {0} is longer than the {1} characters it holds. Shorten it and load the row again.

labels.shortDescription: Load one object: unreadable value; {0} field, {1} the value
labels.value: "{1}" is not a value {0} accepts. Fix the cell and load the row again.

labels.shortDescription: Load one object: the row has no value in any mapped column
labels.value: This row has no value in any mapped column, so there is nothing to load.

labels.shortDescription: Load one object: record ID of another object; {0} the ID, {1} object
labels.value: "{0}" is the ID of another kind of record, not of {1}. Check the Salesforce record ID column.

labels.shortDescription: Load one object: no record the user can see has the ID
labels.value: No record you can see has this ID. Check the ID, or ask your Salesforce administrator for access to the record.

labels.shortDescription: Load one object: an earlier row names the same record
labels.value: An earlier row of this file names the same record. Keep one of the rows, or load the other in a file of its own.

labels.shortDescription: Load one object: the row has no upsert value; {0} is the field
labels.value: This row has no {0}, which the upsert matches rows on.

labels.shortDescription: Load one object: several records hold the row's external ID
labels.value: More than one record has this row's external ID, and the template says to reject such a row. Fix the duplicates, or choose Use the most recently changed.

labels.shortDescription: Load one object: lookup finds no record; {0} field, {1} the value
labels.value: No record you can see matches "{1}" for {0}. Check the value or the field it is found by, or choose Leave it empty to load the rest of the row.

labels.shortDescription: Load one object: lookup finds several records; {0} field, {1} value
labels.value: More than one record matches "{1}" for {0}, and the template says to reject such a row. Find it by a unique field, or choose Use the most recently changed.

labels.shortDescription: Load one object: match only, and the row would create a record
labels.value: No record matches this row, and this file only matches, so nothing was created. To create it, untick Match only and load the row again.

labels.shortDescription: Load one object log: a mapped field is never written; {0} the field
labels.value: Not loaded: {0} is kept by BarnCRM or by Salesforce and is never imported over.

labels.shortDescription: Load one object log: some lookups left empty; {0} is the field
labels.value: Some rows name no record you can see for {0}. They were loaded with it left empty, as the template says.

labels.shortDescription: Load one object log: a lookup to several objects; {0} is the field
labels.value: {0} can point at more than one kind of record, so it is read by Salesforce record ID only.

labels.shortDescription: Load one object log: lookup field unsearchable; {0} lookup, {1} field
labels.value: {0} is found by {1}, which you cannot search by, so no record was found for it. Choose another field in the columns step.

labels.shortDescription: Undo: a journaled record was not created by this import's commit
labels.value: Kept: this record was not created by the person who ran this import while it ran, so the undo left it in place.

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: heading and button of the one-object mapping section
labels.value: Load One Object

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: what a one-object mapping is for
labels.value: For a file that is not a list of people: program sessions, volunteer hours, or a corrected export of one of your objects.

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: picker for the object a new mapping loads
labels.value: Object

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: name of a new one-object mapping
labels.value: Template name

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: button that creates a one-object mapping
labels.value: Create

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: picker for the field a lookup column names its record by
labels.value: Find it by

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: picker for what each row does to the object
labels.value: What each row does

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: the Insert load operation
labels.value: Create new records

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: the Update by record ID load operation
labels.value: Update by record ID

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: the Upsert by external ID load operation
labels.value: Update or create, matched by external ID

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: what Insert does and risks
labels.value: Creates a new record for every row. Risk: loading the same file twice creates every record twice.

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: what Update by record ID does and risks
labels.value: Changes the record whose Salesforce record ID is in the row; map that column to Salesforce record ID. Nothing is created. Risk: a wrong ID changes the wrong record.

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: what Upsert by external ID does and risks
labels.value: Finds the record by the ID field you choose and changes it, or creates one when no record has that value. Risk: a value typed into the wrong row changes the wrong record.

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: picker for the external ID field an upsert matches on
labels.value: Match rows on

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: the object has no external ID field to upsert on
labels.value: This object has no field marked External ID that you can read, so rows cannot be upserted. Choose another action.

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: what a row does when a lookup finds no record
labels.value: When a lookup finds no record

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: option to reject a row whose lookup finds nothing
labels.value: Reject the row

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: option to load a row with the lookup left empty
labels.value: Leave it empty

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: what rejecting a row with a missing lookup risks
labels.value: The row is rejected and listed with the reason. Risk: you fix those rows and load them again.

labels.shortDescription: Import wizard: what leaving a missing lookup empty risks
labels.value: The row loads without that lookup, and the run log says so. Risk: records arrive without the link you meant them to have.
